annotations.title: Get a sprite from a SpriteForge edit session

description: Returns the current state of a SpriteForge edit session: a preview image, its size and palette, how many edits were saved, and a PNG URL with the exact pixels at 1x (add &frame=N for another frame). With include_pixels it also returns the palette-index grid. Read-only.

include_pixels.description: Also return the palette and index grid (default false).

session_id.description: An edit session's id (the s= value of an edit link), or the edit link itself.

name: get_sprite
title: Get a sprite from a SpriteForge edit session
